analysis.title: China Grid Tech: Power Transformer Export Tracker: Oct total transformer exports -2% yoy but exports to US at 348% yoy
key_insights: China large (>10MVA) transformer export value was -2% yoy in Oct (vs -3% in Sep), the third consecutive month of decline with the decline narrowing. GS notes the weakness reflects recent shipment rather than order intake.
China transformer exports to the US grew +348% yoy in Oct (vs +614% yoy in Sep), about Rmb532mn / USD80mn. Mix shifted toward larger units, 78% from 10-220MVA and 22% from 220-330MVA.
South Korea large transformer exports were +142% yoy in Oct (vs +53% in Sep) at USD192mn, with USD147mn to the US (+114% yoy vs +126% in Sep). Korea showed a relatively stronger trend than China.
US pricing was stable with a sequential uptick in Oct. US PPI for power and specialty transformers rose 1.9% mom to 5.5% yoy, and switchgear and gas turbine PPI reached 14% and 4% yoy.
China 10-220MVA transformer export ASP to the US was +16% yoy in Oct (3-month rolling Aug-Oct +32%). The 220-330MVA ASP was -30% yoy (3-month rolling -34%).
South Korea large transformer export ASP to the US was +65% yoy in Oct on a low base, +12% mom. GOES and copper, the key raw materials, saw sequential price upticks in Oct.

GS expects the US local power transformer demand/supply gap to narrow from 72% in 2025 to 61% by 2030E as local capacity comes online. The rest of the gap is likely filled by Brazil, Turkiye, Europe, Southeast Asia, then China.
Global major players' aggregate transformer capacity is expected to roughly double by 2030E vs 2025. 2026 YTD announcements revised total capacity up 3-6% in 2027E-30E vs end-2025.

For Sieyuan, GS models gradual transformer margin declines from increased competition, partly offset by high-margin GIS and EHV/UHV products. It stays positive on global share gains and grid investment.
Domestic China grid investment is forecast at an 8% CAGR in 2026-30E, supported by over Rmb5tn of 15th FYP investment. GS expects stronger UHV tendering in 4Q26 with NARI Tech a key beneficiary.
Other China export categories: electronic meters +41% yoy in Oct (text) and circuit breakers >72.5kV +37% yoy (vs +58% in Sep).

market_movers.rationale: Global share gains from customized, responsive service and grid investment, with transformer margins expected to decline gradually on rising global capacity. Rated Buy at Rmb106.65 price as of the disclosure.
Key beneficiary of stronger UHV tendering expected in 4Q26. Rated Buy at Rmb24.92.
Described as offering defensive mid-teens EPS growth and a c.3% yield. Rated Buy at Rmb18.48.

sector_views.rationale: Domestic grid investment gives visible growth and global grid capex is driven by renewable integration and aging infrastructure, though global transformer capacity additions pressure margins.
